notes: Existing kiosk already has a 20s idle timer that calls resetState()+show('attract'), but (a) it wipes the basket with no warning or way to continue, and (b) resetState() does not clear the DOM selection classes on ticket cards / zone chips, so the next customer sees the previous customer's selection still highlighted. Expect guidance about idle/session reset on a shared device, a warning-before-wipe step, a visible countdown, and full clearing of prior-customer data.
